$comment: Normative node/mark registry for ADR 0001 (GIN-298). Single source for the TipTap extension set, the JSON validator allow-list, the Markdown parser/serializer tables and the HTML renderer. status=live ships today; status=planned is new scope inside GIN-297. Fixtures: apps/api/tests/fixtures/content/

version.description: bumped only on breaking change; see ADR 0001 section 7

paragraph.markdown: blank-line-separated block. textAlign has NO markdown representation and is dropped on markdown export (documented lossy attr).

level.note: editor exposes 1-3 only (rich-editor.tsx:95); parser accepts 1-6 and clamps

text.markdown: literal text; markdown special chars escaped on export

language.note: language="mermaid" is the mermaid source block; SVG is NEVER stored

listItem.markdown: list item body, nested by indentation

checked.note: GIN-78: checked state must persist through every round trip

entityId.note: maps to the existing entity_identifier attr

label.note: display fallback captured at insert time

mention.unresolved: render label in unresolved state; JSON written back unchanged

table.tiptap: @tiptap/extension-table — NOT INSTALLED. prosemirror-tables 1.8.5 is present transitively via @tiptap/pm.
table.note: No editor table support exists today; renderSimpleMarkdown (src/lib/docs/markdown.ts:28) renders pipe tables on the document read path only.

tableCell.markdown: cell; colspan/rowspan have no GFM representation and are dropped (documented lossy)

raw.note: preserved byte-for-byte on write; this is what makes additive schema changes non-breaking

unknownBlock.tiptap: new node with a passive node view
unknownBlock.markdown: rendered as a fenced block with info string `gigsnano-unknown`

bold.markdown: `**`, or `__` when the preceding run ended with `*` (avoids fusing into an ambiguous `***` delimiter run)

italic.markdown: `*`, or `_` at a `*` boundary. NOT `_` by default: CommonMark forbids `_` from opening or closing inside a word, so a mark starting mid-word would be silently dropped.

strike.markdown: `~~` (GFM). Serialized innermost, against the letters — `~~` needs a word character on the inside to bind.

underline.markdown: NO markdown representation — dropped on export (documented lossy mark)

lossyOnMarkdownExport: a run carrying two or more marks immediately followed by a word character (`**~~old~~**new`) — whichever mark is outermost, its closing delimiter is preceded by punctuation and followed by a word character, which fails CommonMark's right-flanking rules. The text always survives; only the marks are dropped. Separated by a space, the same content round-trips exactly.

canonicalizations.$comment: Normalisations validate_doc applies so that two documents meaning the same thing compare equal — required for GIN-305 dual-write divergence detection.
canonicalizations.mergeAdjacentText: neighbouring text nodes with identical marks are joined, as ProseMirror does on every transaction
canonicalizations.markOrder: marks are sorted into registry declaration order
canonicalizations.mergeAdjacentLists: sibling lists of the same type fuse; Markdown cannot express two adjacent lists of one kind, and neither can the editor
canonicalizations.splitMixedLists: a GFM list holding both plain and task items parses back as consecutive bulletList/taskList runs
canonicalizations.softBreaks: a soft wrap is whitespace and rejoins the paragraph

maxNesting.$comment: markdown-it's recursion guard. Its default of 20 loses content from merely deeply-indented real documents; 100 clears any hand-written document while still bounding the parse. A documented ceiling, not silent loss.

unsupportedMarkdownConstructs.policy: parsed as literal text; never errors, never silently vanishes
constructs: raw HTML blocks and inline HTML

notStored.mermaidSvg: rendered client-side at view time with securityLevel:'strict'; never persisted, never returned by an API. SVG upload is already blocked server-side (features/images/router.py:36-38).
notStored.derivedHtml: generated from JSON; the legacy *_html column is a rollback surface, not a source of truth.
